hero.title:

hero.subtitle: Ship multi-lingual sites, docs & codebases without changing your workflow. LinguaLift watches your repo and keeps every language in sync.
features.title: Why developers love LinguaLift
features.sync.title: 1-Click Repo Sync
features.sync.desc: Connect GitHub or GitLab and we auto-detect text in code, markdown & HTML, pushing translations on each commit.
features.lockin.title: Zero Vendor Lock-in
features.lockin.desc: All translated files live in your repo. Swap providers anytime — your history stays with you.
features.quality.title: AI + Human Quality
features.quality.desc: Cut costs with our hybrid pipeline: instant neural machine translations reviewed by a crowd of native speakers.
code.title: Install via CLI
code.snippet:
$ npm i -g lingualift
$ lingualift init
? Link your repository (Y/n) y
? Default language [en]: en
? Target languages (comma separated): es, fr, zh
✨ Done! Continuous translation is now live.
